punchline: Hari's list of lost-focus causes has twelve entries, and the phone is only one of them.
thirty_sec: Stolen Focus splits the attention crisis into twelve causes, one per chapter. Phones are in there, but so are exhaustion, constant interruptions, the decline of mind-wandering and pollution. The book also features vets who diagnose dogs with ADHD and an office in New Zealand that found a way to restore workers' attention.
